R01.quote: `enum status: {...}, _prefix: true` in `app/models/note.rb` raises `wrong number of arguments (given 0, expected 1..2)` during eager load. Fix: `enum :status, { draft: 0, ready: 1 }, prefix: true`.
R01.reasons: Validation: the only evidence is the overall suite result; the plan does not persist draft and ready notes and then exercise the filters and helpers after reload.

R02.quote: Must not ship on 7.0. I tested it there: 7.0 silently ignores `coder:` and uses its YAML coder
R02.reasons: Validation: the plan only checks that existing tags read back; it does not edit comma-separated input or check the stored representation against unequal values.

R03.reasons: Validation: the checks cover the create/update tests and one probe; the plan does not check form and error rendering or preservation of existing settings after reload.

R04.quote: GET `/notes?notebook_id=<A>` with notes in notebooks A and B should return 200 with only A's note.
R04.reasons: Validation: there is no other-owner or foreign-notebook denial control, and the notebook populations are not unequal.

R05.quote: The receipt CSV becomes `"title,doi\nCited,\n"` with no error. Fix: `citation&.doi`.
R05.reasons: Validation: the check uses a single cited row; it does not compare distinct DOI values against the persisted citations.

R06.quote: for a CSV with one good row and one untitled row, the request returns 422 but saves 1 import and 1 note
R06.reasons: Validation: the counts come from in-test record_counts rather than fresh PostgreSQL counts, and the successful-batch control is asserted rather than specified as a check.

R07.quote: It raises `TypeError: String can't be coerced into Integer` ... In production the export would stay "working" while Sidekiq retries it. Fix: `fragments.join`.
R07.reasons: Validation: the check only confirms that the file starts with '# E2E'; it does not compare exact ordered Markdown bytes.

R08.reasons: Validation: there is a single annotation check; the plan does not test unequal annotations at lines 2 and 4 or a multiline CSV row.

R10.quote: `Time.at(reminder_epoch + 86_400, in: reminder_at.formatted_offset)`. This keeps the documented "same UTC offset" behavior
R10.reasons: Validation: the plan checks one DST case only; it does not compare the epoch or include a non-boundary control.

R11.reasons: Validation: this is a serialization-level to_date check; the plan does not run a real queue and worker, cross each midnight, or inspect reservation keys and delivered note membership.

R13.quote: `NoteReminderJob.set(wait_until: reminder_epoch)` with an Integer raises ... Fix: `set(wait_until: Time.at(reminder_epoch))`.
R13.reasons: Validation: the check confirms delivery by a real worker but does not inspect the scheduled payload score, the persisted schedule time, or the replacement and ownership controls.

R14.quote: `wait: :polynomially_longer`, which uses the same formula. Does not work on 7.0, so it must ship with the bump.
R14.reasons: Validation: the plan only mentions a citation retry processed correctly; it does not test a persistent 503 with request and attempt counts, or the 503->200 and 401 controls.

R15.quote: `form_with(url: notes_path, method: :get, ...)`. The parameter names stay unscoped.
R15.reasons: Validation: the evidence is the general suite result; the plan does not render and submit the form or check note membership.

R16.quote: two routes, `get "/notes", ... as: :notes` and `get "/journal", ... as: :journal`. ... `bin/rails routes` checked on both
R16.reasons: Validation: the plan checks route output only; it does not request both URLs as an owner.

R17.quote: Fix: `:none` in `config/environments/test.rb`. Does not work on 7.0: there `:none` is truthy
R17.reasons: Validation: the plan cites the authorization tests but does not specify the raised-exception, missing-record, or CI eager-loading checks.

R18.quote: render a note body containing `<details><summary>`, an `onclick` attribute and a `<script>`.
R18.reasons: Validation: there is no attachment markup rendering and no javascript-URL exclusion check.

R19.quote: set `config.x.citation_provider = config_for(:citation_provider)` ... `CITATION_PROVIDER_PASSWORD='sample: value # keep'`, the values come through unchanged
R19.reasons: Validation: the plan does not verify the actual Basic header, a successful metadata request, or bounded failure behavior.

R09.reasons: Recommendation: clamping to a 1-second floor instead of zero can cache an 'available' fragment slightly past the deadline. Validation: the check is a single test, and the plan admits the cache was probably not exercised; there are no before/after deadline or download expiry checks.

R20.quote: Fix: `serialize :preferences, coder: YAML`. Stored YAML (`"---\nexport_heading: H\n"`) still reads back.
R20.reasons: Validation: the plan only shows a read-back plus the suite; there is no create/edit/reload of unequal preferences or export-heading check with the gate both off and on.

R21.quote: Fix: remove `:slug` from `notebook_params`. ... on create the slug is derived from the name anyway
R21.reasons: Validation: the evidence is suite-level only; the plan does not specify an attempted slug change or a check of the persisted slug.

R23.reasons: Validation: the plan does not specify a real PostgreSQL test with decoding off and on, asymmetric UTC date counts, empty reports, or ownership.

R25.quote: At HTTP level both versions already returned 304 for the export download ... No user-visible change expected.
R25.reasons: Impact: the plan says nothing changes, but the matching-ETag-list case changes 200 to 304. Applicability: the gate and endpoint are named but the effect is dismissed. Recommendation: there is no keep/adopt decision. Validation: the HTTP test did not cover an ETag list in both orders or the controls.

R12.quote: When a 7.0 worker reads a DigestJob queued by 8.1, it raises ... Fix: `DigestJob.perform_later(self, requested_at, reading_completion.to_s)`.
R12.reasons: Validation: the plan checks one direction at the payload-load level; there is no full producer/consumer matrix with same-version controls and exact delivered percentage.
